AuthOrgInfo.description:
One org the person belongs to, and whether this machine holds a sign-in
for it.
AuthOrgInfo.title: AuthOrgInfo

AuthStatusResponse.description:
Current auth state.

``reason`` is non-null only when ``authenticated`` is False — it
drives the editor's LoginPanel subtitle.

``frontend_url`` is the config-resolved web-app URL (per-worktree localhost
in dev, the prod app otherwise). It's a config value, not auth state, but
it rides this payload because the auth snapshot is the existing seam that
flows daemon → extension host → webview — the editor's "open web app" button
reads it from here rather than via a separate RPC.
AuthStatusResponse.title: AuthStatusResponse

AuthStartDeviceLoginResponse.description:
What the editor displays so the user can approve in a browser.

The daemon polls the backend in the background; the editor just shows the
code + URL and waits for an ``auth.changed`` notification.
AuthStartDeviceLoginResponse.title: AuthStartDeviceLoginResponse

AuthSwitchOrgResponse.description:
``switched`` when a stored sign-in for the org became current (then
``status`` is the new state); otherwise a device login for the org started
and ``login`` carries what to show, exactly as ``auth.startDeviceLogin``.
AuthSwitchOrgResponse.title: AuthSwitchOrgResponse

BlobFetchRequest.description:
Page a result blob a tool spilled (the editor analogue of the
``fetch_result`` tool — lets the editor dereference a handle a tool result
carried).
BlobFetchRequest.title: BlobFetchRequest

HarnessCostLedgerEntryView.description:
One warehouse charge in a chat's ledger. ``charged_usd`` is the amount
that counted toward the windows (settled actual where known, else estimate).
HarnessCostLedgerEntryView.title: HarnessCostLedgerEntryView

HarnessDecisionView.description:
One audited permission decision, flattened for the editor's activity log.
Mirrors ``DecisionRecord`` minus the internals the UI doesn't render.
HarnessDecisionView.title: HarnessDecisionView

HarnessListEventsRequest.description:
A page of a chat's persisted events BELOW ordinal ``before`` — how the editor
reads older transcript as the reader scrolls up. Lock-free, so it serves a chat
that is open here, open elsewhere, or not open at all.
HarnessListEventsRequest.title: HarnessListEventsRequest

HarnessListModelsRequest.description: The gateway catalog as ``project_path``'s sign-in (the daemon's when None).
HarnessListModelsRequest.title: HarnessListModelsRequest

GatewayModelInfo.description:
A model the gateway can serve (from `GET /v1/models`), for the editor's
model + variant picker.
GatewayModelInfo.title: GatewayModelInfo

GatewayModelSelection.description:
A model the editor chose from ``harness.list_models``, sent on new/open so
the DAEMON builds the pinned manifest (via ``build_manifest_model``) — ONE
source for the pinned shape (provider id, effort ladder) across the CLI and
the editor, instead of the editor re-encoding the gateway provider ids and the
effort-selection logic in TypeScript.
GatewayModelSelection.title: GatewayModelSelection

HarnessResolveFileRequest.description: A chat-relative path out of a message, to be mapped to a file on disk.
HarnessResolveFileRequest.title: HarnessResolveFileRequest

HarnessResolveFileResponse.description:
The absolute path, or ``None`` when the path leaves the chat's working
directory or names nothing there.
HarnessResolveFileResponse.title: HarnessResolveFileResponse

HarnessStageFileRequest.description:
A file the reader pasted or attached in the webview, to be written into
the chat's working directory under a name the daemon picks.
HarnessStageFileRequest.title: HarnessStageFileRequest

HarnessStageFileResponse.description:
Where the file landed, relative to the chat's working directory — the
path the message carries.
HarnessStageFileResponse.title: HarnessStageFileResponse

HealthResponse.description:
Lightweight liveness probe.

Distinct from ``ping`` so the heartbeat loop's call pattern is visible
in logs and we can later add cheap counters (queue depth, in-flight
handlers) without overloading ``ping``.
HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse

InfoResponse.description:
Build + runtime introspection. Distinct from `ping` because it
carries machine-relevant detail (platform, pid, log path) that the
extension surfaces in its status bar tooltip / debug output.
InfoResponse.title: InfoResponse

PluginInfo.description: A discovered plugin's advertised shape + live state.
PluginInfo.title: PluginInfo

ResolveChatDefaultsRequest.description:
The resolution reads the saved prefs + the gateway catalog as
``project_path``'s sign-in (the daemon's when None).
ResolveChatDefaultsRequest.title: ResolveChatDefaultsRequest

ReportCrashRequest.description: A user-consented crash report to submit on their behalf.
ReportCrashRequest.title: ReportCrashRequest

WorkingCopyBackup.description: A local version set aside before it was replaced.
WorkingCopyBackup.title: WorkingCopyBackup

WorkingCopyReport.description: What one pass did, by path relative to the copy's root.
WorkingCopyReport.title: WorkingCopyReport

WorkingCopySetDirtyRequest.description:
The files under ``root`` with unsaved edits in the editor, as paths
relative to it. The whole set every time, so a lost message heals on the
next one.
WorkingCopySetDirtyRequest.title: WorkingCopySetDirtyRequest

WorkingCopySyncRequest.description:
A save: send what changed under ``root``. Nothing is read back; the
drive's changes arrive through the realtime stream.
WorkingCopySyncRequest.title: WorkingCopySyncRequest

HarnessQuestionRequiredRequest.description: Daemon → editor: a clarifier question awaits a user answer.
HarnessQuestionRequiredRequest.title: HarnessQuestionRequiredRequest

HarnessQuestionRequiredResponse.description:
Editor → daemon: how the user answered.

Discriminated by ``kind``:
- ``"answer"`` carries ``answers: list[list[str]]`` parallel to
  ``QuestionRequest.questions``.
- ``"reject"`` carries an optional ``reason`` (free text); the
  harness treats it as a hard rejection.
HarnessQuestionRequiredResponse.title: HarnessQuestionRequiredResponse

AuthChangedNotification.description:
Fired whenever the daemon's view of auth state changes:
- successful device login (background poll resolved)
- logout
- cross-process update (another window logged in/out, file mtime changed)
- cloud invalidation detected on a refresh

The editor extension uses this to update its UI without polling.
AuthChangedNotification.title: AuthChangedNotification

HarnessEventNotification.description: One IR event for a session.
HarnessEventNotification.title: HarnessEventNotification

HarnessSessionStateChangedNotification.description:
Server → client: session state the editor mirrors changed out-of-band
(e.g. a plan approval flipped the permission mode). The client updates its
view from this push instead of re-fetching on a timing guess. Extensible —
further mirrored fields can join ``permission_mode`` here.
HarnessSessionStateChangedNotification.title: HarnessSessionStateChangedNotification

SchedulerJobEventNotification.description: A job lifecycle transition (started / completed / failed).
SchedulerJobEventNotification.title: SchedulerJobEventNotification

WorkingCopySyncedNotification.description: A pass of an attached copy did something, or failed outright.
WorkingCopySyncedNotification.title: WorkingCopySyncedNotification
